                    double dy = p.y - circles[i].center.y;
                    double angle=Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                    if (angle<0) angle+=2*Math.PI;
                    angleList.add(angle);
                }
            }

            Collections.sort(angleList);
            Point dir=new Point(1,0).scale(circles[i].r);
            Double[] uniqueAngles=new TreeSet<>(angleList).toArray(new Double[0]);
            for (double ang: uniqueAngles){
                Point p=circles[i].center.add(dir.rotate(ang));
                assignPoint(p, pointIndices, adjacency);
            }
            for (int j=0;j<uniqueAngles.length;j++){
                Point p1=circles[i].center.add(dir.rotate(uniqueAngles[j]));
                Point p2=circles[i].center.add(dir.rotate(uniqueAngles[(j+1)%uniqueAngles.length]));
                int u=pointIndices.get(p1);
                int v=pointIndices.get(p2);
                if (u!=v){
                    adjacency.get(u).add(v);
                    adjacency.get(v).add(u);
                }
            }
        }

        int totalVertices=adjacency.size();
        int totalEdges=0;
        for (List<Integer> adjList:adjacency) totalEdges+=adjList.size();
        totalEdges/=2;

        boolean[] visited=new boolean[totalVertices];
        int components=0;
        for (int i=0; i<totalVertices; i++){
            if (!visited[i]){
                components++;
                explore(i, visited, adjacency);
            }
        }

        int answer=1+components+totalEdges - totalVertices;
        pw.println(answer);
        pw.close();
    }

    static class Point implements Comparable<Point> {
        double x,y;
        Point(double x, double y){this.x=x; this.y=y;}
        Point add(Point p){return new Point(x+p.x, y+p.y);}
        Point sub(Point p){return new Point(x - p.x, y - p.y);}
        Point rotate(double a){
            double c=Math.cos(a), s=Math.sin(a);
            return new Point(x*c - y*s, x*s + y*c);
        }
        Point scale(double f){return new Point(x*f, y*f);}
        double length(){return Math.hypot(x,y);}
        @Override public int compareTo(Point p){
            if (Math.abs(x - p.x) >1e-8) return x<p.x?-1:1;
            if (Math.abs(y - p.y) >1e-8) return y<p.y?-1:1;
            return 0;
        }
        @Override public boolean equals(Object o){
            if (!(o instanceof Point)) return false;
            Point p=(Point)o;
            return Math.abs(x - p.x)<1e-8 && Math.abs(y - p.y)<1e-8;
        }
        @Override public int hashCode(){return Objects.hash(x,y);}
    }

    static class Circle {
        Point center;
        int r;
        Circle(Point c, int r) {this.center=c; this.r=r;}
        boolean contains(Point p){return Math.abs(p.sub(center).length() - r)<1e-8;}
    }

    static List<Point> intersect(Circle c1, Circle c2){
        double dx=c1.center.x - c2.center.x;
        double dy=c1.center.y - c2.center.y;
        double d= Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        double cosA=(c1.r*c1.r+d*d - c2.r*c2.r)/(2*c1.r*d);
        if (cosA < -1-1e-8 || cosA >1+1e-8) return null;
        if (cosA< -1) cosA=-1;
        if (cosA>1) cosA=1;
        double alpha=Math.acos(cosA);
        Point dir=c2.center.sub(c1.center).scale(1.0/d);
        List<Point> res=new ArrayList<>();
        res.add(c1.center.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(+alpha)));
        res.add(c1.center.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha)));
        return res;
    }

    static void assignPoint(Point p, Map<Point,Integer> idMap, List<List<Integer>> adj){
        if (!idMap.containsKey(p)){
            int id=idMap.size();
            idMap.put(p, id);
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    static void explore(int u, boolean[] visited, List<List<Integer>> adj){
        visited[u]=true;
        for (int v:adj.get(u))
            if (!visited[v]) explore(v, visited, adj);
    }
